description: This file is a PHP script for generating and displaying a printable report in the vtiger CRM application. It initializes report components, applies date filters, generates report data, and renders the report using a Smarty template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class extended for vtiger CRM.

classes.name: Reports
classes.description: Class representing the report entity, used to manage report metadata and operations.

classes.name: ReportRun
classes.description: Class responsible for executing report queries, applying filters, and generating report data.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: Utility class for handling date/time conversions between user and database formats.

methods.name: RunTimeFilter
methods.description: Applies date filters to report data based on user input.

methods.name: GenerateReport
methods.description: Generates report content or total summary based on filters.
